prompt: Original educational conceptual illustration, landscape 3:2. Warm ivory paper, sophisticated hand-painted gouache/watercolour, confident fine brown outlines, navy lettering, restrained teal, coral and amber. Editorial science illustration with spacious composition and large legible labels. The explanatory structure must carry the meaning visually: molecules, objects, geometry or flow; never paragraphs in boxes. No organs, regional anatomy, teeth or joint cutaways, tissue layers, invented histology, diagnostic photographs, radiographs or patient data. All symbols are explicitly conceptual. Footer: 'Conceptual teaching model • Not to scale'. Title 'Protection supplied as antibodies', subtitle 'Passive immunisation'. Left a small unbranded vial containing simple Y-shaped antibody tokens labelled 'Preformed antibodies'. Arrow from vial to a strong teal shield at centre labelled 'Prompt protection'; several Y tokens float around the shield without binding any objects, no molecular binding orientation needed. A long unnumbered time ribbon runs rightward from shield to a lighter translucent shield labelled 'Protection wanes', with a small hourglass. The centre shield is protective metaphor, not an absolute guarantee or patient. Short note 'VZIG: one selected post-exposure use'. No person, needle injection, organ, immune cell factory, memory cells, medicine doses or dates.

teaching.question: What makes passive immunisation useful when protection is needed promptly?
teaching.answer: It supplies antibodies that are already formed, so protection can start promptly. It is temporary; it does not create durable immune memory by itself.

title: Protection supplied as antibodies
caption: Passive immunisation supplies preformed antibodies for prompt but temporary protection. Varicella-zoster immunoglobulin is one example used after qualifying exposures in selected susceptible high-risk patients.
alt: Preformed antibody tiles move from a supply vial to a shield; the shield becomes lighter along a time ribbon to show waning protection.

review.notes: Preformed free antibody tokens lead directly from vial to shield; no binding orientation or host antibody-production process is invented. A translucent later shield and hourglass show waning. VZIG is explicitly one selected use, with no dosing, universal prophylaxis rule or injection anatomy.
